purpose: Test whether the exact historical audio independently supports a nonzero musical grid/downbeat origin, and quantify whether V154's fixed t=0 mapping omitted a required audio-to-score origin. This is diagnostic only and does not generate, modify, select, or score a candidate.

fixedTempoForControlledAudit.note: This audit isolates origin/phase only. A future production architecture must estimate tempo reference-blind as well.

audioOnlyEstimator.onsetNovelty: positive first difference of log RMS plus positive first difference of log first-difference RMS, smoothed over 3 frames
audioOnlyEstimator.beatPhaseScan: scan one beat period at one-hop increments; maximize robust capped mean onset novelty sampled at fixed-tempo beat locations during first 60 active seconds
audioOnlyEstimator.barPhaseScan: score each of four beat residue classes by capped mean onset novelty; choose highest residue as downbeat class
audioOnlyEstimator.originRule: earliest beat in winning downbeat residue at or after activityStartSeconds - one beatPeriod

v154LatencyDiagnostic.allowedInput: consumed frozen V154 generated.json only; no professional reference
v154LatencyDiagnostic.purpose: Measure generated onset timing relative to raw-mix onset peaks as a diagnostic of transcription/separation latency. It is not used to choose the audio-only origin estimate.

successInterpretation: Freeze the audit output regardless of result. Only after freezing may its audio-only origin estimate be compared to the already-frozen V154 post-score phase diagnostic. Use the result to design a new preregistered architecture, never to correct V154.
